text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads up — final release notes draft attached below. We're on the midnight change window; need ops + legal ✅ and a rollback roster. Can folks please confirm by EOD PST?

Kevin Liu: reading now. any hotfixes landing in this batch?

Maria Chen: No new feature toggles. Just small perf bump, two model pin updates, and an embedding schema tweak.

Sasha Ortiz: embedding schema tweak — is this backwards compatible? need to flag SDK folks if not.

Maria Chen: It's additive; compatible. SDK ping for v0.9.2 release notes already queued.

Kevin Liu: OK. Rollback lanes? what are the criteria this time?

Jamal Reed: propose rollback if error-rate > 3% on p99 latency or if there are > 5% invalid-embedding regressions on smoke prompts. Those were the thresholds we used last time.

Maria Chen: agreed. Add: immediate rollback if cold-start OOMs occur on dedicated pools.

Sasha Ortiz: tagging @DeployBot to schedule canary. DeployBot: please schedule a 10% canary for 00:30 UTC, then 50% at 01:00 UTC if green.

DeployBot: scheduled canary -> 10% at 00:30 UTC, rollout plan: pause at 01:00 UTC for manual checks. Reaction: :rocket:

LegalBot: quick note — privacy blurb updated for EU customers, please include the two-line copy in the RN.

Maria Chen: added the EU privacy blurb to the draft.

Kevin Liu: ops checklist for oncall: make sure the paired rollback runbook is on standby (ops-runbook v3). Also confirm metric dashboards pinned.

Jamal Reed: ops-runbook v3 is linked here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ops-runbook-v3 — oncall, please ack.

Sasha Ortiz: will alert SDK leads about v0.9.2 microcopy changes.

Maria Chen: copy block for internal announcement (paste into #all-hands draft):

```
Heads up — deployment tonight at 00:30 UTC (canary), rolling to full by ~02:00 UTC if all checks pass. Highlights: performance improvements for streaming, pinned model revisions for inference stability, and a minor embedding schema addition (backwards compatible). No user-facing UI changes. If you operate downstream integrations, expect token response shape to be identical; embedding clients may see an extra field `embedding_metadata.version`.
```

Kevin Liu: tiny nit: change "~02:00 UTC" to "expected by 02:00 UTC if healthy". less definitive.

Maria Chen: updated.

Sasha Ortiz: QA request — can we run the smoke harness against canary before 01:00 UTC? I can trigger the suite.

Jamal Reed: pls run `./scripts/smoke-check --canary 10` and post results. If failure >3 tests, halt and rollback.

Sasha Ortiz: running now... output: 2 failed/120 — both transient timeouts on embedding service. Investigating.

Kevin Liu: transient timeouts ok if under threshold, but track p95/p99.

Maria Chen: ops, please keep me updated. If regressions spike, we'll pin back to previous model revision and abort further rollout.

DeployBot: canary metrics report posted: https://deployboard.internal/canary/1789990123 — overall error-rate 0.9%, embedding invalid rate 1.2%, p99 latency +4% vs baseline. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

Sasha Ortiz: smoke harness rerun after small config tweak: 0 failed/120. good.

Jamal Reed: taking point for rollback roster: if we need to revert, my team will initiate `deploybot rollback --to=rev-2026-03-15` and notify leads.

Maria Chen: leave a manual hold at 01:00 UTC for human sign-off before 50% step. Team leads, be ready for the hold.

Kevin Liu: ack — I'll monitor p99 and embedding invalids.

Sasha Ortiz: ack — will monitor smoke and SDK alerts.

LegalBot: legal approves the announcement copy. Reaction: :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: final checklist:
- legal ok (done)
- deploybot scheduled canary (done)
- ops runbook linked & oncall ack (done)
- SDK leads notified (done)
- internal announcement copy ready (done)

Maria Chen: if no objections, I'll post internal announcement 3 hours before window and trigger canary per DeployBot schedule.

Kevin Liu: no objections from me.

Sasha Ortiz: good to go.

Jamal Reed: ready on rollback lane.

DeployBot: standby for `deploybot promote` command at 00:35 UTC.

Maria Chen: thanks everyone — posting draft to #all-hands in T-3h. Reaction: :party_popper:
